BiblicalUsage: Jibnijah is Ibnijah, an Israelite of Benjamin, named beside Ibneiah in the same verse. In 1 Chronicles 9:8, Ibneiah the son of Jeroham.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ibnijah matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident.
